overview: AssamRoots is an Assamese-first e-commerce platform for discovering and purchasing authentic Assamese products — including tea, food, handloom, handicrafts, books, and more. Inspired by Flipkart and Blinkit for fast browsing and easy checkout, the platform serves Assamese users in Assam, across India, and abroad.
features: Product discovery with category-led browsing and search
Admin product management with image upload
Mobile-first responsive design with Assamese branding
